name: SSDI Live Transfers

hero.headline: SSDI Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for ssdi solutions.

overview: SSDI Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Connect people who can no longer work due to a medical condition with advocates who help pursue Social Security Disability benefits.

Live transfers add a qualification layer before the representative engages. Our team confirms that the person is unable to work, that the condition is expected to be long-term, and that they are seeking help with an application or appeal, and verifies TCPA consent before warm-transferring the call. This is especially valuable for advocacy firms with limited intake capacity, because the pre-screen filters out consumers who are already working or clearly outside the program before they reach an authorized representative.

This product is suited to insurance businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of ssdi consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Adults who are unable to work due to a physical or mental medical condition expected to last twelve months or longer, and who are either preparing an initial application or appealing a denial. The strongest segments are claimants with a recent work history, those who have already been denied once and face an appeal deadline, and people who feel overwhelmed by the paperwork and want representation.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for help applying for disability benefits; unable to work due to a medical condition; received a denial and wants to file an appeal; approaching an appeal or reconsideration deadline.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "SSDI benefits help" and "social security disability application", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard ssdi criteria include: currently unable to work due to a medical condition; condition expected to last twelve months or longer; has a qualifying work history or is exploring eligibility; located in the united states; seeking help with an initial application or an appeal; provided tcpa consent to be contacted about disability assistance.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.a: Yes. Every consumer provides TCPA consent before contact and is connected only with advocates or authorized representatives. Programs make no claim of government affiliation and never promise guaranteed approval of a claim.

faq.q: Can claimants be filtered by stage of the process?
faq.a: Yes. Delivery can prioritise initial applicants, consumers facing a denial or appeal, or both, so your intake team receives the situations your representatives are best equipped to handle.

faq.q: How are expectations managed with claimants?
faq.a: Messaging focuses on helping the consumer pursue the benefits they may be entitled to. It does not promise a specific outcome, and consumers understand they are being connected with a representative, not a government agency.
